justifications.durability: negative-control.log reverts the carry in a head tree and reddens the same test (assert 1 == 2, EXIT=1); independently the test fails against base _backends.py and passes against head.
justifications.evidence: gate-base-tests.log records 3 failed/450 passed at 9b66ff8a including the new test's failure; an independent extraction of base 9b66ff8a with the test added reproduces assert 1 == 2, and the head tree d114f187 passes.
justifications.fit: the carry follows the stream_state idiom already used for fold and timestamps; _carried_malformed guards a non-int malformed value, though the guard would read the same inline.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/_backends.py:3471 sets obs.malformed_lines = malformed + _carried_malformed(carried) and stores the total back into stream_state, matching the section's malformed half exactly.
justifications.scope_discipline: the two commits touch only reckon/_backends.py, the new test file and the evidence fragment, all within the manifest's declared write paths.
